bodies.scope: Begin-block loop visits 0x510-byte rows, selecting only a raw INT64_MIN sentinel at row+0x378. A nonnegative millisecond scalar derived from the captured timestamp is divided by row+0x3c0. Row+0x3c8 changes only when the quotient exceeds it, before a strict-advance flag is handed to the existing reset_recent_ois guard. Zero divisor is not guarded at this site. Generic date conversion and guard cleanup are supporting context; actual financial OI semantics and completion of the callback remain unresolved.
